visualValidation.outfit: Original2003 Jade: short black swept hair, green cloth headband (no hat), green lipstick and eyes, darkgreen cropped jacket, white tank top, teal/green swirl-pattern trousers, brown sneakers, dark fingerless wrist gloves, compact round-lens camera and retractable blunt metallic Daï-Jo.
visualValidation.weapons: Physical Daï-Jo staff; personal special is informational camera use with zero damage; no offensive camera ray, sword, shield or firearm.
visualValidation.stature: One190px effective anatomical stature shared by all10sources; native crouches, prone and hanging bodies retain their lower projections.
limitations: New generated pixel-art adaptations, not official source animation frames; source1to1Verified remainsfalse.
Continuous shield states depict staff bracing/evasive recovery; original2003 usesdodging. Platform-fighter shields/aerials and timings are declared adaptations.
Opposite facing mirrors the sprite at runtime and is not counted as newart; anatomical equipment handedness in mirrored camp is not source-certified.
